finding_status.notes: Closed in src/pages/analytics/__tests__/AnalyticsPage.test.tsx by adding two cases to the 'CLI Analytics feature flag gate' suite: a project admin with isAdmin:false and a projects array containing is_project_admin:true asserts data-cli-analytics-enabled='true', and a companion case with an all-false projects array asserts 'false', pinning the .some() predicate in both directions. Verified non-vacuous by mutation: replacing '(isAdmin || isProjectAdmin) && isCliAnalyticsConfigEnabled' with 'isAdmin && isCliAnalyticsConfigEnabled' fails exactly 1 of 10 tests; the source was restored and re-verified afterwards.

Fixed at src/pages/analytics/__tests__/AnalyticsPage.test.tsx:205. The key was corrected from the nonexistent 'features:localAnalytics' to the production 'features:cliAnalytics' (AnalyticsPage.tsx:52), and the mock catch-all was changed from [false, true] to [true, true] so the corrected branch determines the outcome instead of being shadowed by the default. Safe because AnalyticsPage reads exactly three flags and all three are handled explicitly in the mock. Verified: the suite collects and runs rather than silently skipping.

Fixed at src/pages/analytics/components/cli-analytics/views/SessionTimeline.tsx:137; the React key is now a composite of dispatch.label and index, so duplicate labels can no longer collide. Verified by typecheck and the cli-analytics unit suites.

Fixed at src/pages/analytics/components/cli-analytics/views/UsersView.tsx:311 by adding 'if (clicked && !clicked.user_id) return' ahead of handleDrill, so a row that cannot be drilled into is no longer highlighted. Guarding on clicked preserves deselection, since clicked is undefined when a click removes an already-selected row. Verified: UsersView unit suite passes.
